_note: General-market-trend state machine thresholds. fall_pct/rally_pct/ftd_pct are percent (e.g. 0.25 = 0.25%). vd_window_calendar_days is CALENDAR days (confirmed); breach_check_trading_days and ftd_search_trading_days are TRADING days (sessions) - 'next 2.5 days' was rounded up to 3 trading days since the source rule didn't specify a convention for a half-day with daily bars; tighten to 2 if you want the breach-check to be more lenient instead of more conservative.
